method: Composite = weighted mean of per-signal z-scores (population SD, over the species that have the signal): 0.55 llm, 0.10 enwiki, 0.15 tcg, 0.10 wikidata, 0.10 polls. Enwiki gets a low weight because its 12-month views mostly reflect whether a species has its own article (memes and competitive history), not whether kids know it. When a species lacks a signal its other weights are re-normalized to sum to 1. Transforms: log1p on enwiki 12-month views, TCG card counts and Wikidata sitelinks. llm = mean of the raw 1-10 lens scores present (kid2026, parent, merch), then z-scored. Raw scores are averaged instead of per-lens z-scores because merch only covers part of the dex; on dex 1-512 merch differs from mean(kid2026, parent) by +0.01 on average, so a missing merch score does not bias a species. tcg = z of the 50/50 blend of z(log1p(all cards)) and z(log1p(cards since 2020)). All-time counts favour species printed since 1996; the recent count reflects what kids pull from packs now. polls: per source, score = 1 - (rank - 1) / U, with U = the number of species the poll ranked from (the 'all N species' in its scope, else 1025), not the list length, so a top-30 list does not score its 30th place near 0. Absent = no information. Species score = mean over the sources that list it, then z-scored over the species with a value. Pokémon of the Year 2020: the per-region top-30 lists are ranked overall by their votes (comparable across regions) and used in place of the worldwide top 30, which is the first 30 of that same vote order, so the same ballots are not counted twice. Ranks 1-1025 by composite (ties by dex). Tiers by rank: 1 easy 1-120, 2 medium 121-350, 3 hard 351-650, 4 master 651-1025. Hand overrides in data/popularity-overrides.json (each with a reason) then move species: a rank override takes that exact rank, and a tier override puts the species in that tier, or pins it there when it is already in it. Tiers keep their sizes: the slots a tier has left after rank overrides go to the species overridden into it, then to the rest in composite order. Gaps this run: "Pokémon of the Year 2020 (worldwide top 30)" replaced by its per-region lists ranked overall by votes (same ballots); polls: 866/1025 species, weights re-normalized for the rest; 83 override(s) applied from data/popularity-overrides.json.
